steps.subject: sky
steps.action: crisscross pink glow in the sky
steps.load: brush tapped into crimson
steps.motion: crisscross strokes with very little pressure
steps.rule: keep the glow soft, not too bright

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: lavender mix tested in the sky
steps.load: crimson with a tiny bit of blue on the same brush
steps.motion: test and blend in the sky

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: block in the mountain outline with lavender
steps.load: lavender roll on the knife edge
steps.rule: only the outside shape matters at this stage

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: pull the mountain base out with liquid white
steps.load: liquid white on the large brush
steps.rule: mist and haze soften the light at the base

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: knife dabs of highlight and shadow on the mountain
steps.load: least touch of white on the knife
steps.rule: mountains far away so little detail is needed

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: foothill blocked in with a lavender mix
steps.load: crimson, a little blue and a touch of white

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap mist under the foothills
steps.load: clean 2in brush

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: darker foothill layer in front
steps.load: same mix, a little darker with a touch of sap green
steps.where: in front of the first foothill
steps.rule: closer things are darker in value so they stand apart

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap mist at the base of the foothill
steps.load: clean dry brush

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: far hills in the distance
steps.load: lavender with a tiny bit of sap green

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: darker hill layers closer to the viewer
steps.load: same mix with a little more green
steps.rule: closer hills get a bit darker

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: evergreen trees pushed up with the fan brush
steps.load: lavender with a little white loaded full
steps.motion: touch for center then push upward

steps.action: meadow highlights with yellows and a touch of red
steps.load: yellow mix with a tiny red
steps.rule: blending softens colors and creates depth

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: more evergreen trees pushed up
steps.load: lavender with white on the old brush

steps.load: same lavender on the brush
steps.rule: dead trees make the painting look real

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: old limbs on the dead trees
steps.load: liquid black on the liner

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: base dark color for a new hill, leaving light gaps
steps.load: dark blue and crimson mix
steps.rule: light gaps will create effects later

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: tap light touches of white and red on the hills
steps.load: touch of white with red on the brush

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: highlights with yellow and green on the hills
steps.load: yellow with a little green and red

steps.subject: trunk/limbs

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: more trunks in black and brown
steps.load: same black and brown mix
steps.where: across the mountain, on a small hill

steps.action: quick highlight drops along trunks
steps.load: white on the other fan brush
steps.rule: light from the right is easier for right-handed painters

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: thin black limbs on the trees
steps.load: liquid black thinned with thinner
steps.motion: bring to a point and drop limbs
